text: In one bounded toy model (t=1, k=2, two generated bits), illustrative Python samples record debate_true in 3070 of 4096 trials on the true honest path and debate_false in 3057 of 4096 trials on the false honest path; these are descriptive samples from this toy generator only and do not prove a universal premise or a deployed-system claim. Exact finite enumeration reports minimum success 3/4 over all 8 deterministic history-only Bob policies on oracle true_75 and all 125 deterministic Alice policies on a 5-point claim grid on oracle false_75.
